paper: Towards Robust and Efficient Federated Low-Rank Adaptation with Heterogeneous Clients
adaptation: Preserves alternating freeze, global top-ranked slot selection, one-epoch training-data probe and eta_B/eta_A=5. Global rank4 and per-client average rank budget2 are explicit capacity choices. Probe state and optimizer reset before three masked SGD epochs. Unselected delta slots remain zero even with weight decay/momentum. Common CLIP, initialization and scaling replace native RoBERTa/AdamW protocol.
